Festival Essentials

Where and when does Graspop Metal Meeting take place?

Graspop Metal Meeting 2027 takes place from 17 through 20 June in Festival Park Stenehei, Dessel (Belgium). 

I’d like to work at Graspop Metal Meeting. Where can I apply?

Unfortunately GMM has no vacancies for individual volunteers. However, we have been working with a number of associations for many years. Your association can apply here. 

Would you like to run a merchandise stand in the Metal Market or the Festival Fair?

Submit your application to Orange Artist Promotion (Dido Smit): tel. 0031 (0)70 3856001 or via info@festivalfair.eu.

Would you like to have your food truck at the festival?

Please send an email to yannick@bevers.be to register.
